title: Why the UI is data
summary: A closed grammar can be validated, diffed and patched.
body: A UI described as JSON can be checked before it runs. Mistakes are reported with a path instead of rendering wrongly.

title: Actions are the only writers
summary: One choke point gives logging, replay and tests for free.
body: State changes only through named, typed actions. That makes every session replayable from its action log.

title: Rendering on the server
summary: The same code produces the first paint and the live app.
body: The server runs the same create() the browser runs, so markup and behaviour cannot drift apart.

title: Real URLs
summary: Shareable links, working back button, crawlable pages.
body: History routing needs a server that returns the page for every route. This example's server also renders it.
